pictures.scene: Dore, The Heavenly Host — ring upon ring of winged figures wheeling around a burst of white light at the centre of heaven, the nearest of them bowed and the furthest lost in the brightness, after this i heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting, hallelujah, salvation and glory and power belong to our god
pictures.name: pd_dore_the_heavenly_host

pictures.scene: Memling, The Last Judgement — Christ seated on the rainbow with a lily at one side of his head and a sword at the other, the apostles ranged behind him and the archangel weighing souls on the ground below, for his judgments are true and just, he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality, he has avenged the blood of his servants that was poured out by her hand
pictures.name: pd_memling_judgment

pictures.scene: Van Heil, The Burning of Troy — a whole city alight under a sky of red and black smoke that rolls from one edge of the picture to the other, with small figures fleeing along the lit streets below, and a second time they called out, hallelujah, her smoke rises forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_vanheil_burning_troy

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — a woodcut of God enthroned inside a ring of crowned elders who hold out their harps and their cups, with the four living creatures at the throne and John kneeling at the front of it, and the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped god who sits on the throne, saying, amen, hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Memling, Singing Angels — two young angels in heavy brocade copes singing beside the crowned figure of Christ, their mouths open and their eyes on the same page, then a voice came from the throne, saying, praise our god, all you who serve him, and those who fear him, small and great alike
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ standing inside a blue almond of light on a gold ground with his hand raised in blessing and small angels ringed all round him, and i heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out, hallelujah, for the lord our god the almighty reigns
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Veronese, The Wedding at Cana — a great wedding banquet on a marble terrace with musicians playing at the near table and servants carrying jars among the crowded guests, let us rejoice and be glad and give him the glory, for the marriage of the lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready
pictures.name: pd_veronese_the_wedding_at_cana

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing on an altar in a green meadow with angels kneeling round it in plain white robes, a fountain running in front of them and prophets reading at the near edge, she was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure, for the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Velazquez, Saint John the Evangelist on Patmos — the young apostle sitting with a pen lifted over the open book on his knee and the eagle beside him, a small bright vision shining in the cloud behind his shoulder, then the angel told me to write, blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the lamb, and he said to me, these are the true words of god
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_saint_john_the_evangelist_on_patmos

pictures.scene: Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — an angel bending low over a man who has gone down on the ground, laying a hand on him to raise him up rather than let him stay there, so i fell at his feet to worship him, but he told me, do not do that, i am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of jesus, worship god, for the testimony of jesus is the spirit of prophecy
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Durer, The Rider with the Bow — a crowned rider on a pale horse drawing his bow as he comes forward out of the cloud, with the horse stepping clear of the edge of the world below him, then i saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse, and its rider is called faithful and true, with righteousness he judges and wages war
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_rider_with_the_bow

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — Christ holding out a crown at the top of a flight of pale steps while ranks of saints and angels kneel below him with their backs to us, he has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on his head, he has a name written on him that only he himself knows
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_coronation_of_the_virgin

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Carrying the Cross — Christ in a deep red robe under a blue cloak holding the beam of the cross with both hands and looking up, the crown of thorns pressed on his head and the blood running down his face, he is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the word of god
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_carrying_the_cross

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Knights of Christ — ranks of knights in polished armour riding out under red banners marked with the cross, the foremost of them on a white horse in jewelled harness, the armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow him on white horses
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_knights_of_christ

pictures.scene: Reni, The Archangel Michael — the archangel in a blue cuirass with his sword lifted and one bare foot set on the head of the devil he has thrown down on the rocks, and from his mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and he will rule them with an iron scepter, he treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of god the almighty
pictures.name: pd_reni_archangel_michael

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, God Enthroned — the enthroned figure in a scarlet robe with a triple crown on his head and a line of gold letters running round the arch above him, and he has a name written on his robe and on his thigh, king of kings and lord of lords
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned_ghent_altarpiece

pictures.scene: Thayer, Angel — a winged figure standing straight against an open sky with great pale wings spread wide to either side and the light falling full on her, then i saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, come, gather together for the great supper of god
pictures.name: pd_thayer_angel

pictures.scene: Vereshchagin, The Apotheosis of War — a pyramid of bare skulls heaped up on dry ground under a pale sky, with crows perched along it and more of them circling overhead, so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great
pictures.name: pd_vereshchagin_the_apotheosis_of_war

pictures.scene: Altdorfer, The Battle of Alexander at Issus — two vast armies with thickets of lances and banners filling the whole plain below a walled city, under a sky of torn cloud and burning light, then i saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the one seated on the horse, and against his army
pictures.name: pd_altdorfer_the_battle_of_alexander_at_issus

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint George and the Dragon — a knight in dark armour on a white horse driving his lance down into the dragon sprawled flat under the horse's hooves, but the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_george_and_the_dragon

pictures.scene: Turner, The Burning of the Houses of Parliament — a sheet of white and gold fire going up the whole height of the picture from a building on the water, with the towers behind it half lost in the glare and small dark figures watching from the near bank, both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur
pictures.name: pd_turner_the_burning_of_the_houses_of_parliament

pictures.scene: Liljefors, Sea Eagles — two great eagles over a grey sea, one dropping on beating wings and the other already down in the water tearing at the fish under its feet, and the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the one seated on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh
pictures.name: pd_liljefors_sea_eagles

lines.text: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: Hallelujah!
Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality.
He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.
And a second time they called out: Hallelujah!
Her smoke rises forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying:
Amen, Hallelujah!
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: Praise our God, all you who serve Him,
and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: Hallelujah!
For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory.
For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.
For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
Then the angel told me to write, Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
And he said to me, These are the true words of God.
So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus.
Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse.
And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head.
He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood,
and His name is The Word of God.
The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure,
follow Him on white horses.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter.
He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh:
KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead,
Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men,
of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled
to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs
deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive
into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse.
And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
